answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before it may vote on a task or claim a reward. The protocol caps each bond’s influence, so splitting the same stake across a hundred accounts does not create more weight; each account must lock additional funds. A challenge window lets others flag linked accounts, with proven duplicates slashed. An atlas of public bond histories helps auditors spot an echo of one operator across the ocean of agents, while the attacker pays in capital tied up and lost if caught.
